text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?! Are you all truly going to eat 
the "Cursed Carrot Ice Cream"...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... The infamous new carrot ice cream 
flavor, "Jingisukan Flavor"... is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I hear that the moment you taste it, an 
indescribable saltiness and gaminess 
spread thickly across your tongue...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nah, its real danger ain't the taste.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Every single person who took a bite out of 
curiosity... somehow ended up hit by 
bizarre bad luck that very same day!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Stupid mistakes on quizzes, forgetting 
their racing shoes—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Word is one girl even singed her tail when 
her hair dryer malfunctioned, right?

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Thanks to that, rumors started 
spreading that it's cursed, and now not a 
single one will sell...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please do not worry, Clerk-san. That jinx, 
I will break it without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Once everyone sees that this ice cream 
isn't cursed, I'm sure they will gladly 
pick it up again!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whatcha starin' at over there?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Don't tell me... hearing that got 
your challenger spirit burning up with a 
fiery bang, eh!?

text_block_list.name: School Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Even the Trainer!? Y-You're a lifesaver, 
truly~~~!!

And just like that, before anyone could 
object, the clerk brought out four 
popsicles...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, this... is one wild color. What do ya 
call it? ...Muddy purple-black?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I sense quite an ominous presence from 
it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You sure about this, Satono? My gut's 
telling me... this is one dangerous 
gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You've still got the right to take the 
safe road back, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, Nakayama-san! I will never back down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because no outcome is ever decided―― 
before you even try.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What brings about the result is always our 
actions and our unbreakable will!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Hahaha!! Well said, you 
fascinating little lady!!

Sensing an overwhelming atmosphere where 
backing out was impossible, I braced 
myself and ate the popsicle alongside 
Satono Diamond and the others!

Just as the rumors said, a truly 
indescribable flavor filled my entire 
mouth...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-I finished it...! All that remains now 
is whether misfortune will strike, but...
choice_data_list: Let's lay low as much as possible...
Let's go check if misfortune happens!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Laying in wait for it to come straight at 
us, huh. Heh... that's plenty amusing in 
its own right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then, everyone! Let us brace ourselves and 
await it...!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, infiltration success at last! Which 
girl should I interrogate first? I'm gonna 
hit 'em with tons of tricky questions~!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Ain't that the perfect target right 
there? Excuse meee――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!! Look who finally showed up!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tired of waiting for ya, HEY PUNK, 
ORAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Reporter
text_block_list.text: Gyaah!? S-Somebody saaaave meee!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...? What was that person's deal just now?

And thus, having splendidly (?) broken the 
jinx, not a single misfortune befell 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wahoo~ We're taking the fight to them, 
huh!? Sounds awesome! Move out, troops!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So we march around and wait for something 
to happen. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First stop: we're marching all the way to 
France or somethin'!
choice_data_list: No, let's keep it on campus...!

text_block_list.text:
And so, we paraded around the academy 
grounds alongside Satono Diamond and the 
rest, but――

Before this crew charging boldly without a 
shred of fear, not a hint of misfortune 
showed up all the way to the end!
And then――

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, one Genghis Khan flavor, 
please! Ah, we want one over here too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! A massive hit today as well, isn't 
it?♪

Clearing its bad reputation, the unique 
flavor became famous for being 'somehow 
addictive,' and all the stock successfully 
vanished.
However――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Oh no, they're left unsold 
again...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...!? The bad rumors should be 
completely gone by now...!
choice_data_list:
...Could it be because it's 'Genghis Khan 
flavor'?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eh?
